title: Pairing deep link / QR payload
description: Canonical string built only by the hub; identical in Admin-UI QR, copy link and integration camera. 'uri' is the exact string, 'params' its decoded query. tools/validate.py checks that both agree.

url.description: Base URL of the hub without trailing slash; percent-encoded in the URI. Resolution: app_url, X-Forwarded-Host (not Ingress), routable Host (not Ingress), host of ha_internal_url + :8099, local IP + :8099.

hn.description: The household's home networks (client_config.home_networks), comma-separated canonical CIDRs, percent-encoded in the URI; only when the list is not empty. Lets the app accept a hub host inside them before it is paired (e.g. a Tailscale address 100.x.y.z). The app takes from it only networks inside the private ranges of $defs/home_network_cidr and only for this pairing.

x-client-rules: The apps accept only the scheme of namespace.json deep_link_scheme (no aliases), host must be 'pair'.

Only local hosts (RFC1918, loopback, link-local, ULA, .local, localhost) or hosts inside a network listed in hn (only private ranges incl. 100.64.0.0/10 are taken from it); CGNAT/Tailscale without hn rejected.
Only when not paired; confirmation dialog; PIN is prefilled, never sent automatically.
